subject: website
name: web3audio.eth
summary: Web3 Audio, a wallet-native audio tools, marketplace and radio site. No public source was found. It stays at Level 2 because it runs third-party code when it opens: ethers from cdn.jsdelivr.net with no integrity hash and the GoatCounter analytics script from gc.zgo.at.

connections.name: cdn.jsdelivr.net (ethers 5.7.2)
connections.note: Script loaded when the page opens without an integrity hash.

connections.name: GoatCounter (gc.zgo.at, web3audio.goatcounter.com)
connections.note: Analytics script and a visit ping sent when the page opens.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Stylesheet and font files fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.

connections.name: dbloops.com and stream.dbloops.com
connections.note: Now-playing, marketplace and community data fetched from the project server, repeatedly while the page is open.

connections.name: api.coinbase.com
connections.note: ETH price fetched when the page opens.

connections.name: api.ensideas.com
connections.note: ENS names of listed addresses resolved when the page opens.
